title: Stasis Chamber Map
description: A top-down isometric view of an intricate fantasy dungeon map labeled 'STASIS CHAMBER' at the bottom. The central feature is a glowing cylindrical glass pod containing a dragon, surrounded by concentric circular stone platforms, pathways, glowing runes, magical crystals, waterfalls, torches, and various connected chambers including a prison cell, library, and fungal grotto.
prompt: Top-down isometric fantasy dungeon map of a stasis chamber, central glowing cylindrical glass pod with a dragon inside, surrounded by concentric circular stone walkways with glowing runes, connected to multiple themed rooms including a barred prison cell with spiral floor, a library with bookshelves, a glowing crystal and mushroom grotto, underground river with lily pads, waterfalls, stalactites, torches, and magical artifacts, dark atmospheric lighting, detailed game asset style
